info.name: Services Mobile API v1
info.description:
# Services Mobile API (v1)

Source of truth: `routes/api.php` under `/api/v1`.

## Apps
- **Customer app**: guest browse (home/catalog/search) + register/login for orders/payments/profile
- **Technician app**: login only (no register; created from Platform/Company admin), offers, order status, items
- **Public**: banners, companies, CMS pages (no auth)

## Auth
- Laravel Sanctum Bearer token
- Customer login/register returns `{ token, token_type: "Bearer", user, customer }`
- Technician login returns `{ token, token_type: "Bearer", user, technician }`
- **Auth-optional (guest OK):** `GET /customer/home`, `/search`, `/service-categories` (+ children / problems / intake-fields), `/available-technicians`, `/booking-preview` — valid Bearer enriches home/favorite fields; missing token still returns 200
- **Auth required:** profile, notifications, addresses, favorite-technicians, orders, pay-*, invoice, devices, feedback, complaints — `Authorization: Bearer {{customer_token}}` or `{{technician_token}}`

## Locale
- Query `?locale=ar|en` or header `Accept-Language: {{locale}}`
- Middleware: `SetApiLocale`

## Response shape
- API Resources typically have **no** top-level `data` wrapper (`JsonResource::withoutWrapping`)
- Paginated lists may still use Laravel pagination keys (`data`, `links`, `meta`) depending on endpoint

## Technician list / favorites
- `GET /customer/available-technicians?service_category_id=&lat=&lng=&filter=available|all|favorites`
  - `available` (default): available + GPS + approved
  - `all`: approved + GPS (includes busy/offline/on_break)
  - `favorites`: auth required; favorites for the category coverage
- Response fields: `rating_average`, `rating_count`, `availability_status`, `distance_km`, `is_favorite`, `user.avatar_url`, `company.display_name`
- **No ETA fields from API** — mobile computes arrival minutes from `distance_km` later
- Favorites CRUD: `GET/POST/DELETE /customer/favorite-technicians` (auth required)

## Typical customer flow
1. GET /customer/home (guest) → browse catalog/search
2. GET /service-categories (roots) → /{id}/children (subtypes; empty skips) → /{leaf_id}/problems → intake-fields
3. GET /available-technicians?service_category_id={leaf_id}&filter=available|all|favorites (technician linked to root covers children)
4. GET /booking-preview?technician_id=&service_category_id= (guest OK: technician card + company discount + price list + inspection_fee)
5. POST /customer/register or /login → save token (needed before create order / favorites mutation / pay)
6. POST /favorite-technicians/{id} (optional heart)
7. POST /addresses (if needed)
8. POST /orders
9. Pay placeholders / invoice (auth required)

## Typical technician flow
1. POST /technician/login → save token
2. PATCH /availability, PATCH /location
3. GET /order-offers → accept/reject
4. PATCH /orders/{id}/status + manage items

## Controllers
`app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/{Public,Customer,Technician}/`

item.name: Customer / Catalog
item.description:
Auth-optional guest browse for choose-service:
1) GET /service-categories → root circles only (parent_id=null)
2) GET /service-categories/{id}/children → subtypes for segmented bar ([] skips)
3) GET /service-categories/{leaf_id}/problems → title + description_ar/en + icon_url
4) GET intake-fields → available technicians
5) GET /booking-preview?technician_id=&service_category_id= → technician + company + price list + inspection_fee (guest OK; optional q search)
6) Create order / pay inspection still require auth (Bearer).

request.description:
Auth-optional guest screen for technician card + company offer + searchable price list + inspection fee CTA.

Response `data`:
- `technician` — TechnicianResource (display_name, rating_*, availability_status, distance_km, user.avatar_url, is_favorite)
- `company` — CompanyResource (display_name, logo_url, offer_text, active_discount_type/value)
- `price_list` — active/default list meta (nullable)
- `price_items[]` — display_name, price, discounted_price, currency, duration_minutes
- `inspection_fee` — resolved fee string (demo seed = 5.000)
- `currency` — e.g. KWD
- `is_favorite` — false for guests; real value when customer Bearer present

No ETA from API — derive arrival minutes from `distance_km` on mobile.
Pay inspection / create order still require `Authorization: Bearer {{customer_token}}`.
